name: gamenet_player_row_destroy_embedded_panel
description: GameNetPlayerRow::DestroyEmbeddedPanel destroys the embedded HUD panel subobject in a player row.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent GameNet player-row/HUD panel source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x434650 validates thiscall self in ECX, adding 0x64 to reach the embedded HudUiPanel subobject, and tailcalling HudUiPanel::Destructor.
The native player-row smoke verifies DestroyEmbeddedPanel resets the embedded panel vtable to HudUiCommon and clears owned panel text state through the HudUiPanel destructor path.
